findings.title: Confirmed automatic connection check can rearm a failed or revoked certificate
Late in-flight verification cannot overwrite concurrent revocation under the current CAS path
An unscoped legacy draft can be listed and deleted through a different workspace
Handoff grouping collapses deliveries that differ only by target activation
Overview always claims no verifiable bill despite retaining provider-reported cost

limitations: User personal UX acceptance remains pending and was not represented as complete.
The supplied native evidence proves requested/reported identities where recorded; physical backend and effective effort remain unknown where not independently proved.
The candidate is a read-only frozen export without .git. Candidate SHA-256 and the 194-file Git tree were independently reconstructed; all 59 supplied evidence-manifest hashes matched.
A fresh frontend rebuild was not executed in this recovery because the isolated review environment has no installed esbuild dependency. Supplied byte-identical rebuild evidence was hash-verified.
This recovery did not read credentials, native transcripts, or hidden reasoning, and did not call models, change authority, commit, push, merge, or promote Stable.
